MEMORANDUM

To: Regional Operations Leads
From: S. Okonkwo, Director of Operations
Date: 14 February 2024
Subject: Q4 FY2023 fulfilment performance and Q1 corrective actions

Dear colleagues,

Please find below the quarterly review of fulfilment performance, together with
the actions I am asking each region to take before the end of Q1.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Order accuracy across the network held at 97.2% for Q4 FY2023, broadly flat
against Q3. Median time-to-dispatch rose from 19 hours to 26 hours, driven
almost entirely by the Bengaluru and Rotterdam nodes.

METHODOLOGY

Figures are drawn from the warehouse management system export for the period
1 October 2023 to 31 December 2023, reconciled against carrier scan events.
Nodes with fewer than 500 orders in the period were excluded.

KEY FINDINGS

1. Time-to-dispatch regression is concentrated in two nodes. Bengaluru moved
   from 17 to 34 hours; Rotterdam from 21 to 29 hours.
2. Peak-week staffing was 12% below plan across the network.
3. Order accuracy is stable, so the regression is a throughput problem rather
   than a quality problem.
4. Carrier handover delays account for roughly a third of the Rotterdam gap.

RECOMMENDATIONS

We recommend that each region submit a peak staffing plan for Q1 by the end of
this month. We recommend that Bengaluru pilot the revised pick-path layout.
We recommend that procurement reopen the Rotterdam carrier contract.

I would be grateful if each of you could confirm receipt and nominate a single
owner for the actions above. I am happy to walk through the underlying data on
request.

Thank you for your continued effort through a difficult quarter.

Regards,

S. Okonkwo
Director of Operations
